process.title: How I work
process.ownership: You own everything I build — source code, repositories, and accounts, handed over at completion.

scope.label: Scope
scope.text: We start from what you're trying to do, not from tech. You get a plain-language plan and a clear price shape before anything is built.

build.label: Build
build.text: I design and build it personally, end to end. You see progress early, while changing direction is still cheap.

launch.label: Launch
launch.text: Deployment, domain, hosting, handover — done with you, in your accounts, under your name.

maintain.label: Maintain
maintain.text: After launch: updates, monitoring, and quick fixes — or a clean handover to your own team. Your call.
